_comment: Known engine bugs the suite currently trips. 'checks' maps fnmatch globs over check ids (<checkpoint>:<query id>:<aspect>) to a key in 'bugs'. Delete a bug and its globs when it is fixed. Some bugs only show up for certain segment layouts, so a listed check that passes is reported but only fails the run under --strict.

bugs.numeric-sort-lexicographic: Integer/Float fields sort as strings, so 10 sorts before 9 (build_sort_value_maps stringifies values; compare_candidate_sort_keys compares strings)
